plan.title: Tofu dogfight: flight, bursts, roll, stall, Vesper
plan.contract:
One biplane duel on flat shapes; start from seed_paddle's layout. Planes are kinematic pack objects (no TLBiped/TLVehicle), 60 Hz frames, own hit-stop. Write data first. Several small files. Never name a variable score*/clock*/timer*/period*/lap*.
DATA. tuning.json holds EVERY feel number here, grouped flight, energy, resources, camera, feel, round, plus these for later packages: swing{enabled true, in_f 8, out_f 18, up 7, dist_add 14, dist_div 1.85, dist_min 18, dist_max 45, cone 30, range 60}, lesson{pass_at_f 720, gap_start 35, settle 8, dive_speed 32, straight_f 120, hull_floor 70, composure_cap 60, safe_radius 90, alt_min 15, alt_max 60}, space{skip_damage 10, skip_stun 40, splat_stun 40, splat_stop 14, splat_shake 0.25, wing_wobble 12, wing_stop 4, predict_f 30}, air{width 14, height 40, hop_f 1200, warn_f 180, energy 0.8, lift 6}. moves.json: short, short_chain, long, charged, roll, stall_turn, finisher (windup, active, recovery, damage, cost, poise_damage, composure). rivals.json: styles barn_door(poise 18), fencer(10), dancer(10); tiers [react,defend,read,return,fire_min,fire_max]: [30,.30,.10,36,8,14],[22,.45,.30,28,15,30],[18,.60,.50,22,15,30],[15,.70,.65,18,15,30]. world.json: radius 150, ceiling 80, river along x at z=0, bridge x=30, hills (0..12 m bumps), obstacles [{id,kind:orchard|vine|house|bridge,center,half,top}] (orchards north -z, vineyards south +z), air_spots [[-50,60],[0,80],[55,55]]. valley.json: tl.layout/1 flat ground, 3 m dry-stone ring wall. gen/planes.gd: hills and flat obstacle boxes (nodes World/Flat_<id>), `static func build(side)` and `static func pose(root,clip,f,total)`, clips gun_burst, gun_long, barrel_roll, hammerhead, using TLStyle.flat_material. Planes 6 m long, 2.6 tall, guns visible; me orange, round cowl, white scarf; rival blue, swept wings, pointed spinner, tall yellow tail, long yellow scarf. Named parts Head, Prop, WingL, WingR, PanelL, Tail, Scarf.
INPUT: left,right,up,down (arrows), throttle W, short_burst Space, long_burst F, roll Shift, look_back C.
FLIGHT. Stick plane-relative: left/right bank+turn, up/down pitch (invert key); free stick levels wings; held up loops. W: speed 10 m/s2 toward 14+0.2*ENERGY; released 8 m/s2 toward 14; floor 8 outside stop/stall. Turn/pitch deg/s: 120 under ENERGY 35, 100 to 70, 75 above; x0.6 in burst windup. DIVE COMMIT: pitch below -30 for 30 f caps turning 50 for 90 f (scream, wings flex); frames with up held never count and reset it (loops exempt). Wind wall at radius/ceiling turns back, costs 15. Temporary floor guard when world.floor_guard: lift to 3 m above top_at.
ENERGY 100, start 60. Costs short 12 (chain 10), long 22, charged 30, roll 20, stall 25, feint 6; perfect roll +10. W and |pitch|<=15: +0.6/f after 20 f (attack) or 24 (roll), up to 60; above 60 bleed 0.1/f. Higher nose: drain 0.7*sin; lower: +0.5*sin to 100; W off: no regen. 0 = EXHAUSTED to 40: coughs, nose drops, windup x1.25, roll recovery +12. Gap >100 and growing: runner no regen, -0.2/f. Under 35 hull regen x1.5, bright exhaust.
VERBS (windup/active/recovery), 8 f buffer. short 30/4/16, chain of 3 from last 4 recovery f, windup 22, dmg 9/7. long 48/5/28 dmg 20, armour f12-53, Shift before f20 feints to roll. charged (F held past 20) 54/6/36 dmg 30, red flash+smoke, beats armour. roll 3/18/15, invulnerable 4-21, toward held side, 4 m up-and-out, speed to 8 within 6 f held to f45; side offset returns, height stays +4 until attacker is ahead or beyond 12 m (max 90 f) then eases 18 f: no ramming; re-roll within 30 f narrows perfect window by 4. stall_turn 20/24/30: release W with nose above 40; speed 3, stick swings nose up to 180, fire from swing f12, no invulnerability.
AIM: no assist; active frame with rival capsule within 7 deg and 60 m, or 2 m of nose line. Once per burst; tracers cross in 6 f.
PERFECT: first active frame on roll f4-13 (judged against roll-start line): roller free 8 f later, attacker OPEN 52 short/36 long/60 charged (no stick, throttle, guns; keeps heading and speed; nothing moves either plane), composure +20/+30/+30, stop 12/14/14, roller's short windup 20, long 32 while OPEN (rival never under 22).
CONTACTS, stop on both. short: stop 6, flinch 18, jolt 1.5 m, wing dips 25, head snaps, scraps+rip, attacker recovery 16. long: stop 13, stagger 40, 4 m, nose down 15, PanelL tears, recovery 28. charged: stop 15, spin 45, recovery 30 invulnerable 1-20. armoured: damage+composure, shudder, scraps, stop 6, keeps firing, attacker full recovery. evade: tracers pass, dry clatter, no burst. clash (same class within 5 f): sparks, noses kick apart, rebound 20 (long 30), stop 8. long vs short: short takes it. counter (windup, stall, roll recovery): stun +10, dmg x1.25. Poise damage 22/42/70 minus poise (me 10): <=0 shudder, 1-15 flinch, 16-35 stagger, else spin. Stun locks controls, heading carries; victim visual shakes decaying in stop. Hull 100. Composure 100: hit +6 short/+14 else, x1.5 from rear 60 deg, clash +12; drain .25/f after 45 quiet (half under 50 hull); full = BROKEN 90 smoking glide, long = finisher 30 dmg, stop 20.
FEEL: visible by f2, full pose f6; shake long .12, finisher .35, shorts none. TLAudio for fire, rip, clatter, roll whoosh; engine ticks faster with ENERGY; Prop speed and wingtip TLVfx.trail read ENERGY.
RIVAL Celeste Vesper, tier 0 barn_door: writes the same intent as the player, sees poses react frames late, ctx.rng, states SPACING, PRESS, DEFEND, PUNISH, RESET (under 30 ENERGY or after OPEN: climb). Presses with armoured longs (tail wags first 24 f), also 3-short chains, rarely evades, fires 8-14 m behind, attacks every 2-3 s in busy and quiet spells, return window, never one string thrice, never idle over 120 f.
ROUNDS: TLRules sides you,vesper, score_to_win 2; round 75 s, ends at hull 0 or larger share. Round 1: rival 35 m ahead weaving gently on a wall-safe circle, both 26 m/s; later head-on 150 m apart, 180 f calm. Space starts next round within 120 f; after match, Space after 60 f restarts. Lights unchanged.
CAMERAS (ctx.cameras.add_view, moved each frame). tail: 12 back, 3.4 up, 1.2 right, fov 55, looks 40 ahead of nose, eased <=8 deg to a rival in front, follow .2, pitches through loops, never rolls; inside ring, >=3 m above top_at, shifts/lifts past slopes; a rear rival within 3 m of the lens-to-plane line raises it up to 3.5 and shifts it away in 8 f. side: three-quarter view of both, level, distance clamp((gap+14)/1.85,18,45).
HUD: crosshair projected on nose line; bottom-left ENERGY bar notched at 60 with thin hull and composure strips; top-right rival hull, composure; top '00 00:75 00' (matches, clock, matches) and round pips; one hint line; off-screen edge arrow.
SHARED API. main.gd members: me, rival, brain{enabled}, combat, world{height_at(x,z), top_at(x,z), floor_guard}, cam{request(pos,look,in_f,out_f): call each frame wanted}, hud, rules, tune, events, round_hold, series[0,0], hint(text,frames). Plane: side,pos,basis,speed,hull,energy,composure,poise,state,state_f,move,move_f,stop_f,exhausted,lift (extra m/s up, reset each tick),blanks,hull_floor,composure_cap,intent{turn,pitch,throttle,short,long,long_held,roll},node, place(pos,yaw,speed), forward(). states fly,windup,active,recovery,roll,stall_windup,stall_swing,stall_recovery,flinch,stagger,spin,open,rebound,broken,splat,down. combat: apply_stop(a,b,f), apply_stun(p,state,f), hurt(p,amount), emit(type,by,on,move,dmg). events {type,f,by,on,move,dmg}: round_start,windup_start,fired,hit,armoured,perfect_roll,evade,whiff,clash,counter,overshoot,stall,broken,finisher,skip,splat,wing,round_over,match_over. MODULES: after setup read ctx.root.get_meta('bd_modules',[]) of {path,order}, sort, ctx.load_script(path).new(); setup(ctx,game), pre_tick(f) after player intent and before brain, post_tick(f) before camera, state(dict). _pack_state: phase fight|round_over|match_over, round, round_left_f, me, rival (pos,fwd,up,speed,hull,energy,composure,state,state_f,move,move_f,stop_f, visible_f), rounds_won, series, events, rules snapshot, module keys.
TOFU CHECK: tests/bot_tofu.gd reports metrics feedback_f, skill_spread, skill_variants, idle_max_f, tell_min_f, tells, pressure_waves, lead_change_share, close_rounds, verbs_used, contact_types, one_sided_contacts
All counted from frames: feedback_f<=3 (press to first visible change, burst); skill_spread .25-.95 and skill_variants>=3 (short only: near tail, far on turning rival, counter, cone edge; >=5 each, mean damage); idle_max_f<=120; tell_min_f>=20; tells>=3; pressure_waves>=2 (busy >=3 starts per 180 f after quiet <=1); lead_change_share>=.3 over >=3 rounds; close_rounds>=1 (loser within 35% hull); verbs_used>=4 (short, long, roll, stall, each >=3); contact_types>=3; one_sided_contacts<=0 (evade excluded). Bot plays through TLHand 'sharp', reports hand and moments {hit,parried (=perfect roll),rolled,clash,knockdown,counter,overshoot,stall_turn,finisher}; it can perfect-roll a lesson pass (press at windup f18-27 short, 36-45 long). tests/support/pilot.gd: setup(ctx,hand), drive(state).
PLAYER CHECK: tests/bot_tofu.gd fails when the player's inputs land fewer than 6 bursts on Vesper or perfect-roll fewer than 1 burst

plan.title: Threat swing, SHIFT lesson and space hits
plan.contract:
Makes the 30 seconds happen as written: 0-5 s both cruise 26 m/s, Vesper 35 m ahead, hint says Space ('I'm flying'); 5-15 s tracers rip blue fabric ('got you'); 15-30 s they loop behind, camera swings sideways, a SHIFT ring closes, I roll, they shoot past underneath, my burst lands ('out-flew them'). KILL IF a newcomer cannot say when to roll or why a burst hit; the swing makes them steer wrong, lose the horizon or hit a hill; they cannot loop on purpose or lose Vesper for 5 s repeatedly.
HOOK. gen/hook_first.gd: static generate(ctx) appends {path:'scripts/first/first.gd', order:10} to ctx.root meta 'bd_modules'. first.gd implements setup(ctx,game), pre_tick, post_tick, state(dict), using only the core's shared API (game.me, rival, brain, combat, world, cam, hud, tune, events, round_hold, series, hint). All numbers from data/tuning.json groups swing, lesson, space (read via game.tune).
THREAT SWING (post_tick): on frame 1 of a rival windup with me within 30 deg of their nose and 60 m, while they are outside the tail frame, call game.cam.request each frame easing over 8 f to a side three-quarter view: pivot midway, 7 m up, distance clamp((gap+14)/1.85,18,45), horizon level, inside ring, >=3 m above world.top_at, take the other side or lift if a slope blocks. At least 22 f of a short tell and 40 of a long remain visible. Hold through burst, roll, overshoot; a chain keeps it; ease back 18 f. Stick stays plane-relative. swing.enabled false and camera ease 0 disable both for comparison. Hold look_back (C): view swings to the rival in 8 f, release returns. Same attack from behind also reddens the edge arrow (own HUD layer), clanks gun cocks (TLAudio.play 'hit_steel'), turns my pilot's Head node toward them.
LESSON (match one round one only; game.round_hold true until done). Both ENERGY 60, 26 m/s; Vesper weaves 35 m ahead on a circle of radius about 100 m, altitude 40, matched speed so holding W never overruns. game.brain.enabled=false; write game.rival.intent in pre_tick. rival.blanks=true until my first perfect roll; rival.hull_floor 70 and composure_cap 60 so free shots cannot nearly kill them. Hints, one at a time: 'ARROWS fly, hold W', 'SPACE: fire when they sit in your sight'; W released 60 f: 'HOLD W'. At frame 720, only when I am within radius 90 and altitude 15..60 (else they lead back toward the centre, hint 'Follow them'), they loop, dive behind at up to 32 m/s, settle 8 m back on my line and fire a long. Not settled in 240 f: break off, retry. HUD SHIFT ring bottom centre (lesson only): shrinks from windup f1, glows white f36-45, closes at 41. Roll early or late: blanks thud, word EARLY or LATE, pass repeats; hits do no damage. Perfect: they fly past and fly straight 120 f for my burst; then blanks false, floors cleared, brain.enabled true, round_hold false, hint 'W released while climbing: stall turn' once. Afterwards, each time I am hit a 90 f hint names why and the answer ('ROLL LATER', 'THEY WERE BEHIND YOU: roll or loop', 'RED SHOT: roll last instant'). Off screen 180 f: 'Hold C to find them'.
SPACE (set world.floor_guard=false): ground, trees, houses, bridge (world.top_at/obstacles) in control: skip off, lose 10, stun 40, nose up, event skip. Stunned or OPEN into them: SPLAT 40, stop 14, shake .25, dust and debris (water: splash), free follow-up, event splat; low passes over the river throw spray. Wing contact: capsules push apart half each in fixed order, both wobble 12 f, stop 4, no damage, event wing; within 30 f of a predicted overlap the higher lifts and the lower dips. No other plane positioning.
state(): lesson{step,pass,result}, cam_mode tail|swing|look.
BOT tests/bot_first_flight.gd (preload tests/support/pilot.gd, TLHand 'sharp'): flies the lesson, rolls once early then on time, one loop on held Up; ok needs lesson done, both an EARLY result and a perfect roll, a swing, a burst landed after the overshoot, floor never penetrated, Vesper hull >=70 during lesson. moments {threat_swing, shift_ring, perfect_roll, overshoot, loop, splat}. bot_tofu must still pass.

plan.title: Three styles, memory, series, warm air
plan.contract:
Pillars: one good pilot whose habits I learn while they learn mine; the tail wins. KILL IF fights become flat circles with fire mashed.
HOOK: gen/hook_season.gd static generate(ctx) appends {path:'scripts/season/season.gd', order:20} to ctx.root meta 'bd_modules'. Use the core shared API: setup(ctx,game), pre_tick, post_tick, state(dict); game.events (round_start, round_over, match_over, ...), rival.poise, rival.intent, game.brain.enabled, plane.lift, plane.energy, game.series, game.hint. Do nothing to the brain while state lesson is unfinished. Numbers: data/rivals.json (styles, tiers [react,defend,read,return,fire_min,fire_max]) and tuning group air.
STYLES by round: 1 barn_door (core brain, poise 18), 2 fencer, 3 dancer (poise 10). For rounds 2 and 3 set brain.enabled=false and write rival.intent from scripts/season/ pilots that use the same verbs, frames, ENERGY, dive commit and 8 f buffer, see only poses react frames old, use ctx.rng, never repeat a string three times, act within 120 f, attack about every 2-3 s with a return window, every attack >=22 f of tell. States SPACING, PRESS, DEFEND, PUNISH, RESET (climb or warm air under 30 ENERGY or after OPEN). Every unarmoured short flinches them in all styles. Fencer: perfect-rolls the third short of a chain and long bursts seen twice, then answers; both wings dip 24 f before the answering string (a hit then is a counter). Beaten by delayed charged shots or fire from beyond 20 m. Dancer: rolls early, stall-turns off a close tail, dashes in from a dive with a three-burst string ending open 20 f; corkscrew coil 30 f before a long. Beaten by punishing roll and stall recovery. Tells are body poses (rival.node parts WingL, WingR, Tail), never words.
TIERS by my match wins this series: 0,1,2; champion rematch after a won series. Tier 0 fires 8-14 m behind; higher tiers 15-30 and feint (long, Shift before f20) to draw rolls. Speed and damage never change.
MEMORY: my last 8 escapes (early_roll, loop, stall), kept across rounds and matches of the session (not saved). With read chance the string ender counters the commonest: early_roll -> charged shot, loop -> held dive, stall -> delayed long.
SERIES: first to 3 matches (at most five); update game.series for the top readout. Rounds are named MORNING, NOON, GOLDEN EVENING in a 120 f banner with Vesper's style line. END: loser trails smoke and glides into the river, winner waggles wings (Vesper winning: smoke-ring loop; losing: scarf trailing). One card: WHAT BEAT YOU (largest damage cause), its answer, what Vesper remembers (e.g. 'you roll early'); Space after 60 f flies again. Won series offers champion rematch.
WARM AIR (twist): one column 14 m wide, 40 tall, hopping among world.json air_spots every 1200 f (order from ctx.rng); flecks stir at the next spot 180 f early (TLVfx.attach plus visible rings of flat flecks built with TLBodies-free visual nodes from TLVfx, readable in captures). Inside, either plane gains 0.8 ENERGY a frame and lift 6 m/s. In the deciding round's last 20 s it settles at the spot nearest the river. First entry hint: 'WARM AIR refuels'. Peaks: first composure break banner BROKEN with horn, rally cue.
DRILL: declare action drill_next with no key; each tap advances the style barn_door -> fencer -> dancer in place.
state(): season{style,tier,memory,air{pos,next,warn},card}.
BOT tests/bot_season.gd (pilot.gd, TLHand 'sharp'): taps drill_next near frames 60 and 300 so all styles act early, flies into the warm air, plays on through at least one match; ok needs each style attacked once, ENERGY gained in warm air, a memory entry, an end card after a match. moments {fencer_riposte, dancer_string, warm_air, composure_break, end_card}. bot_tofu must still pass.

plan.title: Harvest valley, dressed planes, sound
plan.contract:
Visible result, in both the tail and side captures: a bright inked toon harvest valley replaces the flat boxes, and both biplanes gain detail.
HOOK: gen/hook_art.gd static generate(ctx) appends {path:'scripts/art/art.gd', order:30} to ctx.root meta 'bd_modules'. art.gd uses only the core shared API and events; it changes drawing and sound, never rules, positions, frames or state used by play.
VENUE: data/dressing.json (tl.layout/1, built with TLKit.build_layout) placed to match data/world.json obstacles, so what is drawn is what collides and what the camera clears; hide World/Flat_<id> nodes it replaces. Pear orchard rows (kit tree, with yellow-green pears) fill the north; striped vineyard terraces (kit fence and bush) climb the south; houses between (kit house); stone bridge (kit bridge) over still glinting water; forest and mountains outside the 3 m dry-stone ring (kit stones); swirling leaves above the wall show the wind wall. Rolling hills coloured as fields over the core's hill mesh. Nothing taller than the matching obstacle top. No blue in the scenery: the rival's blue is theirs alone. Never create materials, lights or environments; use kit parts, the style's palette and TLStyle.flat_material. Golden evening in round three: use a documented STYLE.md time or palette option if one exists, otherwise warm recolouring of the dressing.
PLANES (gen/harvest.gd static builders attached under the core's named parts): orange plane with cream wingtips, round cowl, pilot in leather helmet and goggles, white scarf; blue rival with swept wings, pointed spinner, tall yellow tail, long yellow scarf. Silhouettes stay distinct and readable against sky and fields; fabric scraps and torn panels still show. Keep parts' names and pose behaviour.
CLIP MOMENTS: perfect roll over red tracers gets a rushing whoosh and a short wingtip ribbon; finisher: smoke trail and splash into the river; loop above the bridge: spray and drifting leaves. No new shake or bursts on shorts or whiffs.
SOUND (TLAudio presets only): engine note cadence follows each plane's ENERGY (rival's too, placed at their position), dive scream while diving over 30 deg, gun cocks clank, fabric rip, whoosh on perfect roll, horn at round end.
BOT tests/bot_look.gd (pilot.gd, TLHand 'sharp'): plays 3600 frames; ok needs the dressing built, both planes dressed and at least one hit; moments {perfect_roll, hit, overshoot, stall_turn}. bot_tofu must still pass.
